title: The toolkit for AI coding agents
heading: Build legible, verifiable systems for AI agents.
description: Terminal workbenches, multi-pass convergence skills and source-linked context packs you can inspect and reuse.

pillars.title: Convergence skills
pillars.subtitle: Review, fix, check, repeat
pillars.body: Use bounded audit-and-fix instructions on code, agent definitions and evaluations. Inspect the passes, checks and stopping conditions before you run them.

pillars.title: Terminal workbenches
pillars.subtitle: Local tools for the work around agents
pillars.body: Inspect installed skills, work in a repository and explore a research library. Choose one application for the task you have.

pillars.title: Agent context libraries
pillars.subtitle: Choose a topic. Take the files.
pillars.body: Load a source-linked Markdown reference or a portable .llms pack. Check its date and sources, then use only the material your task needs.
